title: Zomato-parent Eternal reworking 2030 EV delivery target amid fleet expansion, EV adoption
summary: The company is working towards a revised timeline, factoring in the availability of electric vehicles, supporting government policies, and the transportation requirements of its various businesses.
llm_summary: Zomato’s parent company, Eternal, has pushed back its goal of running a fully electric delivery fleet by 2030, citing the current pace of EV availability, supportive government policies, and the diverse transportation needs across its businesses. The revised timeline reflects a more realistic rollout as the company expands its fleet and aligns its strategy with the evolving EV ecosystem.
